The Company also announced that Amy Rice, President and Chief Operating Officer, and Brad Wright, Chief Financial Officer will attend the Stephens Annual Investment Conference on November 18, 2026. The materials used during the meetings will be posted to the Company’s website that day at
Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Proficient Auto Logistics

is the leading specialized freight company focused on providing auto transportation and logistics services. Through the combination of nine industry-leading operating companies, including four since IPO debut May 2024, PAL operates the largest auto transportation fleet in North America, offering a broad range of services primarily focused on transporting finished vehicles from automotive production facilities, marine ports of entry, and regional rail yards to auto dealerships around North America. For more information, visit www.proficientautologistics.com.

title: Proficient Auto Logistics Sets Date to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results; Announces Participation in Stephens Annual Investment Conference
